cards.direction_or_boundary: Annotated intervals have higher sulfate than their local background across multiple contiguous windows.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Local-median enrichment and rank-based peak checks over multiple contiguous windows.
cards.object: Ordered sulfate intervals and pseudonymized event annotations in one ice-core record.
cards.one_liner: All 14 annotated events are locally sulfate-enriched and almost all are exact local maxima in a 21-row window.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: Independent replicate-core measurements at the same chronology should show local sulfate peaks; failure is no enrichment for most predeclared events.

cards.scope: Event detection in this record; annotations do not establish eruption identity or atmospheric pathway.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The registered data source states that the profile evidences 14 volcanic horizons.
target_alignment.paper_location: PANGAEA dataset description and event annotations for the 0–42 m sulfate profile.

cards.direction_or_boundary: Depth-quartile medians vary little, whereas upper tails vary more and contain the annotated events.
cards.independent_reconstruction_method: Contiguous depth quartiles with event-excluded medians and three-block upper-tail alternatives.
cards.object: The complete ordered sulfate record partitioned into contiguous depth blocks.
cards.one_liner: Robust background sulfate is stable across depth quartiles while upper-tail behavior remains episodic.

prediction.measurement_and_failure_rule: A deeper contiguous extension should preserve a comparatively stable robust background with localized peaks; failure is a block-wide median shift comparable to event peaks.

cards.scope: Robust distributional background, not a causal trend or isotope conclusion.

target_alignment.paper_claim_paraphrase: The source presents a continuous sulfate background punctuated by identified and unidentified event horizons.
target_alignment.paper_location: Source-data sulfate profile and its event-oriented dataset description.

interpretation: These two cards are verified reference discoveries for blind-rediscovery diagnostics and are not an exhaustive answer set.
